what_happened: The predecessor oriented-forest work left an unusually complete landing pad: IsOrientedForest, saturation_of_orientedForest/' (hgen-parameterised), isOrientedForest_swap and ofStepRel_gen are all present in FormalSystem/Semantics/OrientedForest.lean, and TwoWayBounded + plus_invariance_of_isZTime are compiled in HistoryMorphism.lean with translationProduct_twoWayBounded as a two-line worked instance. Research needed no API discovery for the consumer side.

FrameOver.ofStep (FormalSystem/Semantics/IntNormalForm.lean:456) carries a [Finite W] binder solely to discharge saturation via TaskFrame.saturation_of_finite. The universal cover carrier is infinite by construction, so no existing constructor can build the cover frame; a Saturation-parameterised sibling constructor has to be added before the cover can be presented as a FrameOver intOrder.

SuccOrder (coe intOrder) does not synthesise (recorded at FormalSystem/Semantics/ShiftSet.lean:485): instance search runs at reducible transparency and intOrder.carrier is not syntactically Int for the discrimination tree. plus_invariance_of_isZTime takes [SuccOrder (coe D)] [IsSuccArchimedean (coe D)], so any application at D = intOrder must pass them positionally via inferInstanceAs, as ShiftSet.ofIntAction and WitnessFamily.std_isZTime already do.

The dispatch's lean-readiness block reported lean-lsp 'reachable', but the first lean_local_search of the dispatch returned index: unavailable with sources_searched: [source_text] only -- no language server running. Per the dispatch's own interpretation rule this is the degraded tier: every Mathlib and FormalSystem name in the report is evidenced by a grepped declaration site (file:line) rather than an LSP lookup, and no empty result was treated as proof of absence.

FrameOver.taskRel_eq_iter (FormalSystem/Semantics/IntNormalForm.lean:224) proves that EVERY regular frame over intOrder satisfies F.TaskRel w d u iff ofStepRel F.step w d u. The hgen-style generation hypothesis that saturation_of_orientedForest' takes as a parameter is therefore free for the base frame, so the headline cover theorem can be stated for an arbitrary [F.IsRegular] frame over intOrder with no generation side condition and no carrier identification.

Every load-bearing file:line anchor in reports/01 re-derived independently by grep at plan time (ofStep's [Finite W] consumed only by saturation_of_finite; taskRel_eq_iter; TwoWayBounded's two fields; plus_invariance_of_isZTime's four instance binders; IsOrientedForest's three fields). All matched, so no carried figure needed a CARRIED-UNVERIFIED mark and phase decomposition could be taken straight from R5's recommended layering.

Research recommended placing the acyclicity criterion in FormalSystem/ForMathlib/ but did not enumerate the registration cost. Plan-time check found four extra files are required for a new ForMathlib module: FormalSystem/ForMathlib.lean aggregator, the generated FormalSystem.lean root, FormalSystem/Init.lean's recorded-exception docstring, and scripts/CheckInitImportsMain.lean's C24 exemption list. Placement kept at ForMathlib, with the four edits scheduled explicitly as Phase 1 work rather than left to be discovered.

A python in-place string replace used to restructure the plan's Lean Challenge Statements section anchored on the first occurrence of the literal heading string, which was a PROSE mention of it inside the Overview, not the heading itself. The replace therefore deleted everything from the Overview through the challenge block - the Research Integration, Goals, Risks, all seven phases and the Decisions section. Detected immediately because the snapshot tool then reported the section absent and fell back to its R2 git-baseline route. Recovered by rewriting the whole plan from the authored content, after which validate-artifact reported 0 warnings. Lesson: anchor an in-place edit on a line-anchored pattern or on a unique multi-line span, never on a bare heading string a document also mentions in prose.

The three pinned Lean Challenge Statements were compile-verified at PLAN time via 'lean-challenge-snapshot.sh 897 . --dry-run --compile', which reported 'compile: OK' against the project's own toolchain. This confirmed before any implementation dispatch that all three target signatures type-check against existing compiled API - in particular that the headline assembly theorem can be stated with no reference to the not-yet-written cover inductives. Two assembler constraints were also discovered and documented in the plan: declaration names are harvested unqualified (a 'FrameOver.ofStepSat' form harvests as 'FrameOver' and fails the Goals cross-validation), and every import/namespace/open/end line sitting between two declarations is discarded, so the section must be one fenced block with a single preamble.
